title: How Many Bots Can I BEAT with 1 Rook?
summary: Bot ladder with only king + one rook vs full armies of chess.com bots. Zach (1): mated with one rook (Zach actively avoids giving mate). Martin (250): win. Juan (400): first a loss, then a win on retry. Noel (550): rook gets targeted by coordinated pieces, several close attempts, loss - run ends at 3 bots beaten.
rules: Player white: king + one rook (starting square not stated; inferred a1/h1); bot black: full army.
win_condition: Beat as many bots as possible. Video: Zach, Martin, Juan beaten; lost to Noel (550).
